title: Biometric Update | Parsons Launches Multimodal Biometric Identity Platform
summary: Parsons Corporation has launched AresNXT, a new biometric identity management platform designed for use in critical infrastructure, national security operations, and large public events, expanding the company’s role in a market increasingly built around rapid identity verification in the field. The post Biometric Update | Parsons Launches Multimodal Biometric Identity Platform appeared first on Parsons Corporation .
